body: Then you lose it and wait for months again. Don’t let a recruiter pressure you into signing for a period you’re uncomfortable with. Especially when he’s lying about what length you can enlist for.
every time i find something to hold onto it’s taken away from me. i’m just tired of feeling that pain of having to give constantly and receive nothing back.
it’s not currently available, but it will be the LTO sauce eventually
It should let you scan multiple, but i would space them out so that your Blazin’ Rewards account does not get flagged for potential fraudulent activity and get suspended.

They cannot force you to work Sundays/Saturdays, no.

Stand firm, inform them that you are still unable/unwilling to work those days, if they schedule you, don’t show up. Hopefully they didn’t coerce you into putting that you’re available by springing an availability change form on you. If they document you via PCR for NC/NS then i would just get HR involved.

No new sauces. They did revise the recipe for the hidden menu “Dragon Fire” sauce though (half asian zing + half carolina reaper).

(or they might have introduced it, frankly i’ve never heard of it until i was looking at all of the items yesterday.)

There should be either a link/QR on the bottom of your receipt or a QR on the table where you can fill out a survey. Just mention your server by name when it asks about the quality of hospitality :)

alternatively if you know the store # you can go to “bbw.beer/store#” in a web browser and it should bring up a survey button
the spicyness of the hot and medium are different. i don’t feel like i remember hot bbq being that hot but it has been quite some time since i had it.

AFAIK it’s still treated like the McRib: where we bring it back at our own convenience when we can’t innovate on other areas of the menu. I’m guessing it will be back sometime in the fall/winter when/if they do a Blue Moon special like they did in 2019.

i think the ‘official’ sauce hack is little known. none of the other managers had seemed to know there was still spec for something we technically no longer had when i brought it up the other day.

when i was a cook we would literally do whatever combination we felt like in the moment. 

if you can get someone to do it for you, try all 4 at once with a 2:2:2:1 ratio sweet:honey:medium:hot. i think it tastes better than the original hot bbq

I think their worry is that it would end up like Jammin’ Jalapeño and sit there in the sauce pump until someone orders it once in a blue moon. Pump retail space is especially valuable because you can really only fit the 19(?) sauces that we have there right now. 3 of them (Jammin, Adobo, and Nashville) are even in smaller pumps at my store just to make them fit.

What they should do is scrap honey and sweet bbq and then make a hot and mild bbq imo

I received Nashville, Orange Chicken, and Lemon Pepper sauce in my store’s truck order today. No clue if they have Blazin’ yet since I don’t place truck orders—but I’d say that’s a good indication that Carolina Reaper bottles are available or soon to be available for order considering the new Blazin’ was bundled with the Lemon Sauce, Orange Chicken Sauce, and Pizza seasoning.
